name: Ezz Steel
source: Ezz Steel Company (SAE) Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, audited, consolidated statement of cash flows, printed in EGP thousands and stored here in absolute EGP. Read from the exchange-library scan of the signed filing by optical character recognition, and confirmed by the statement's own identity: Operating plus Investing plus Financing equals the printed change in cash and cash equivalents, exactly on both years.
note: All figures in absolute EGP, converted from the statement's EGP thousands. Operating Cash Flow is the printed net cash flows provided by operating activities, after finance interest paid, income tax paid, used provisions and dividends paid to employees and the board. Capital Expenditure is payments for the purchase of fixed assets and projects under construction, stored negative as the dataset convention. Free Cash Flow is derived as Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure. Net Change in Cash is the printed change in cash and cash equivalents during the year.
